name: Iroha Makise
source:
Iroha, the self-described 'sensible' member of the music club, chooses to focus more on her flute practice than to dabble in the excitable antics of her clubmates.

Whilst at first glance, her cynicism may appear to conflict with the club's goals to perform at the graduation ceremony - she too seeks the perfect venue to demonstrate her efforts.

[From Twitter]
